title: Binance Futures Will Launch BUSD-Margined 1000LUNC Perpetual Contracts with Up to 20X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch BUSD-margined 1000LUNC perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage at 2022-05-31 02:45 AM (UTC). Please note:  BUSD perpetual contracts are BUSD-margined futures contracts that use BUSD as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-20x leverage. The  Multi-Asset mode  allows users to trade USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts across multiple margin assets. Users can use USDT as margin when trading BUSD-margined perpetual contracts. Past gains are not indicative of future returns. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of extreme price movements.
